description: This source file defines an abstract class 'ChartRenderer' within the PdfSharp.Charting.Renderers namespace. The class provides rendering logic for chart components, specifically layout calculations for chart legends in a PDF charting library.

classes.name: ChartRenderer
classes.description: Base class for all chart renderers, providing layout and rendering support for chart components such as legends.

methods.name: LayoutLegend
methods.description: Calculates and adjusts the layout rectangle for the chart legend based on its docking position, returning the remaining space for other chart elements.
